about_short_description.short_description: Connect Money offers payment cards and supports digital payments.

product.name: White Labeled Payment Cards
product.description: Issuance of customizable payment cards that support digital payments and cash withdrawals, usable with Visa, Mastercard, and Meeza networks.

product.name: Lending Services
product.description: Provision of credit limits to customers and businesses without bank accounts to increase user retention and generate new revenue streams.

product.name: Rewards and Cashback Program
product.description: A rewards platform offering cashback, discounts, and incentives through a large network of merchant partnerships.

product.name: SaaS Control Portal
product.description: A software platform that allows businesses to manage their banking relationships and user data with customizable insights and controls.

product.name: Managed Financial Services
product.description: End-to-end management of financial services including onboarding, KYC, customer support, fraud monitoring, and back-office operations.
